name: Northcourt EdgeGuard Repair Kit
description: The Northcourt EdgeGuard Repair Kit extends the life of a chipped paddle. It includes three adhesive edge-guard strips, a two-part clear epoxy for sealing small edge cracks, and an alcohol prep pad, enough for two full paddle repairs. Note that added tape changes paddle weight by roughly 0.1 oz.

specifications.contents: 3 edge-guard strips, 2-part clear epoxy, alcohol prep pad

care_instructions: Clean the edge with the prep pad before applying. Let epoxy cure for 24 hours before play, and store the sealed kit in a cool, dry place.
